_comment: GDD 12 F3 hair recolor ramps. Blue is the extraction PROXY; each catalog colour is a 6-step ramp (dark->light) that the blue overlay's per-pixel luminance is mapped onto (interpolated, rank-preserving). Outline pixels (lum<32, neutral near-black) are preserved. blonde brightest lum<=210 (no white-out on pale skin); black keeps >=3 distinct steps.
